output.reason: [ev-685e81f5b751] and [ev-faeed8b582d4] only say that `.status.crossplane.connectionDetails` was removed from the "modern XR" schema because v2 conformance tests treated it as an unexpected field. The proposed exposure is wrong as written. It checks a kind `CompositeResource` in `apiextensions.crossplane.io` that the evidence never names, since XRs are user-defined kinds generated from XRDs. It also tests whether a status field that Crossplane writes is set, which does not show exposure. No evidence, including the changed files [ev-ddd556180e81], says which configuration marks an XR as "modern" or who depended on the field and what breaks for them. Without that, a correct exposure condition cannot be written.
